headline: OpenTrain AI Review: Jobs, Pay & Application Process (2026)
description: OpenTrain AI review covering its role as an aggregator platform connecting AI labelers and trainers with hiring companies.

acceptedAnswer.text: A job aggregator and talent marketplace connecting AI labelers and trainers with companies, pulling together opportunities from 20+ underlying platforms.

Outlier AI is a direct platform (operated by Scale AI) with its own documented hiring process, assessment, and pay structure; OpenTrain AI functions as an aggregator connecting contributors to opportunities across many platforms, including potentially Outlier AI itself.
Roles accessible through OpenTrain AI depend on which underlying platform a contributor is matched to; OpenTrain itself does not have a documented distinct role catalog.
